rules: Ruling SH1: the default share (every member checkbox unticked) names the product and its grade only; each ticked member is added, in response order
no member ticked: key = share.result.product_only, or share.result.product_only_ungraded when grade is null
one or more ticked: key = share.result.text, or share.result.ungraded when grade is null
for each verdict in response order: who = first whitespace-separated word of the member's name; if the name is blank, share.relation.<relation>
status = verdict.status.<status>; one member = share.result.member(who, status)
members = the member strings joined with ', ' (comma + space) in every locale
product = the product name as returned; grade = the letter
link: only when SITE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is set, append ' ' + share.link(url); url = <site>/<locale>[/p/<barcode>]; never a hard-coded domain
never interpolate conditions, allergens, reason codes or nutrient totals
